text:
alex: Deploybot flagged a p95 latency regression on canary (model-v3.4) — 1.8s vs 1.2s baseline. Autopilot applied a hold. https://grafana/reports/abcd :alert:

deploy-bot: autopilot:hold engaged for rollout/2026-03-21T09:12:30Z — reason: p95_latency>1.5s. Suggested action: human review / possible manual cutover or rollback.

maria: copying @sophie @noah. Can someone grab traces + sampling prompt sets? Need repro and whether it's KV-cache related.

sophie: grabbing traces now. quick check: tail of logs shows `kv_cache_miss_rate` spike + several OOM-ish GC pauses on one node.

alex: noted. cs-lead — should we draft a brief customer-facing note in case we need a rollback?

noah: I can roll a targeted traffic-slice back to model-v3.3 for EU region only. Manual steps: `releases/rollback --service inference --model v3.3 --slice eu:20%` (will take ~2m).
maria: prefer targeted cutover vs full rollback if traces point to kv-cache evictions (less customer impact). If we can confirm a single variant/node, we can hotpatch kernel flags.
sophie: confirms one shard shows elevated IO wait. I'm running a `--trace-sample` and will post a short excerpt.

alex: decision: hold remains. Sophie + Maria to confirm root cause within 15m. If we get reproducible KV eviction pattern, Noah to initiate targeted 20% EU cutover to v3.3 and ops to notify affected customers. If not confirmed in 15m, we escalate for full rollback approval from eng-release leads.

deploy-bot: note: rollout hold persists. Manual override allowed by a user with `release:operator` scope.

noah: prepping the rollback CLI snippet and a short rollback playbook: `1) notify #customer-alerts; 2) run rollback CLI; 3) monitor p95, errors, and cost delta; 4) open follow-up ticket` — will paste in thread once ready.

cs-lead: please put a one-line customer blurb ready: "We detected increased latency for a subset of requests in EU; we're performing a controlled cutover to a previous model version to restore latency. We'll follow up with root cause updates."

alex: thanks. keep this thread tight — no wide broadcast until we confirm slice result. :thumbsup:

sophie: trace excerpt pasted to ops drive: https://drive/ops/trace-excerpt-4578912345 — looks KV eviction + one node high IO.

maria: with Sophie confirmation, go ahead Noah. I'll post a short release note update and ping CS once cutover completes.

noah: executing targeted cutover command in 30s, will post status.

(noah updates)

noah: cutover started. `releases/rollback --service inference --model v3.3 --slice eu:20% --wait`

deploy-bot: change: rollout update detected. slice eu:20% -> v3.3. Rolling out.

noah: cutover complete. p95 EU now 1.25s (down from 1.8s). Errors steady.

maria: posting customer note now and creating follow-up ticket for KV-cache investigation.

alex: great. we'll keep the hold until full postmortem. If root cause confirmed and mitigated, we can re-run canary with adjusted kernel flag and smaller slices.

cs-lead: copied. I'll file the customer update once ops confirms the slice is stable for 30m.

alex: thread resolved for now — leave hold open until PM postmortem. Thanks team."
